floor.method: resample each show's critics (one vote per outlet+critic, real tier weights), mean |resample - full|; the second number scales by sqrt(2) because the observed panel is itself one draw. Neither is a hard limit; it estimates the part of the miss that comes from which critics happened to review.

protocol: Walk-forward by season, ridge lambda 20, getCriticScore target, season-clustered bootstrap seed 7314 B=2000. diff = MAE with minus MAE without; negative is better. Verdict helps only if the 95% interval is entirely below zero.
multipleComparisons: Bonferroni over 65 tests (6 single-group primary tests, cast+preview, all inputs together, earlier-run linear and step, two forked cuts, flop and rave tails, three combined models, seven Show Score tests, plus 39 BRO-7373 sweep-2 tests (13 comparisons: six groups vs v1, six groups vs v2, one interaction; each counted for all shows, flop tail and hit tail = 39)). Per-feature rows are exploratory and uncorrected, so a lone exploratory "helps" would not count.

earlierRun.source: research agents scored web reviews of the earlier run (regional, Off-Broadway, West End) found dated before first preview; the model uses only those dated on or before opening minus 3 days (the lag every input uses). Scores are agent-assigned after the Broadway verdict was known: noisy, hindsight risk the date filter cannot remove

sweep2.protocol: diff = MAE with minus MAE without, paired on the same shows, same walk-forward, season-clustered bootstrap seed 7314 B=2000; negative is better. Correction family = the 26 BRO-7347 tests + 39 new (six groups x six cells + the interaction, tails counted).
